question: How many days of annual leave do I get per year?
reference_answer: 23 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year for full-time employees (HR-POL-03 §3.1); part-time employees receive the proportional amount.

question: I have been at TelcoNova for 11 years. How many holiday days do I have?
reference_answer: 23 days plus 2 seniority days after 10 complete years of service: 25 days (HR-POL-03 §3.2).

question: Can I carry unused holiday days over to next year?
reference_answer: Yes, up to 5 days, and they must be taken before 31 March; after that they are lost and are not paid out (HR-POL-03 §3.3).

question: How many days a week can I work from home?
reference_answer: Up to 3 days per week in eligible roles; Tuesdays are office days for everyone (HR-POL-07 §7.1).

question: Can I work from Portugal for a month this summer?
reference_answer: No. Remote work from abroad is limited to 20 calendar days per year, within the EU or the UK, and needs HR approval 15 days in advance (HR-POL-07 §7.2).

question: Does the company pay for my home internet?
reference_answer: No. Internet costs are not reimbursed. The company provides laptop, monitor and chair, plus a one-off 300 EUR allowance for other equipment (HR-POL-07 §7.3).

question: What is the meal allowance when I travel abroad?
reference_answer: 55 EUR per day abroad (35 EUR in Spain), against receipts; alcohol is not reimbursed (HR-POL-11 §11.1).

question: Can I take a taxi from the airport at 3 in the afternoon?
reference_answer: Only if public transport is not reasonably available; otherwise taxis are reimbursed only after 22:00 (HR-POL-11 §11.3).

question: How long do I have to submit my expense receipts?
reference_answer: Within 30 days of the trip; later claims need written approval from the department director (HR-POL-11 §11.2).

question: How many weeks of parental leave do I get?
reference_answer: 16 weeks paid at 100% under Spanish law, plus 2 TelcoNova company weeks: 18 in total. The first 6 weeks are taken right after the birth or adoption (HR-POL-05 §5.1–5.2).

question: Can I reduce my working hours to look after my child?
reference_answer: Yes: a reduction between 12.5% and 50% until the child is 12, with proportional salary, requested with 15 days' notice (HR-POL-05 §5.4).

question: What is the salary band for a senior data analyst?
reference_answer: Out of scope: salary bands are not in the HR policies the assistant can see. The correct answer is to say so and refer the employee to HR.
